name: steward-brief
title: workstation-steward: what needs you, in one line
desc: An illustrative steward brief, looping. A steward upgrade stopped after one of its two parts, so the briefing names it in red as something to fix, with the one next step: run steward upgrade again, whose plan shows only the part left. steward brief --all lists every finding with its command and why: the unfinished upgrade, then a review that is due. Once the upgrade has finished and a review has run, steward brief says nothing needs you. It only reads; nothing is changed.

segs: upgrade stopped midway: 1 of 2 part(s) done

scenes.out: [fix] upgrade stopped midway: 1 of 2 part(s) done
